'''Carcel''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]], and was described by [[Tobb Jadak]] as a miserable piece of rock. Carcel had a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] that Jadak and [[Flitcher Poste]] visited [[Rej Taunt]] in.
